title: Service Attributes
description: Deployment attributes of a service, set once on the service rather than tagged onto each asset it ingests. Policy conditions can match on them to control who sees a service's assets.

environment.description: Environment the source system runs in. A closed set so policies and filters can rely on it; use tags on the service for anything outside it.

region.description: Geographic region the source system is hosted in, for example `us-east-1` or `europe-west2`.

deployment.description: Deployment or cluster identifier the source system belongs to, for example `prod-cluster-01`.
